record.original_question: For a strictly separating intermediate cone C_i in the filtration between the sum-of-squares cone Σ_{n+1,2d} and the cone P_{n+1,2d} of positive semidefinite forms, explicitly describe its dual cone C_i^∨ = {L in Hom(R[X], R) | L(f) ≥ 0 for all f in C_i}.

evidence.quote: In this section, we pose some questions concerning membership tests for Ci’s, investigations of the dual cone C∨ i := {L ∈ Hom(R[X],R) | ∀f ∈ Ci : L(f) > 0} of Ci and generalizations of our considerations about Ci’s to cones along toric varieties.
Open Problem 2. Give an explicit description of C∨ i .

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n,d\ge 1$ be integers and let $\mathbb{R}[X]_{2d}=\mathbb{R}[X_0,\dots,X_n]_{2d}$ denote the vector space of real homogeneous forms of degree $2d$ in $n+1$ variables, of dimension $k(n,d)=\binom{n+2d}{2d}$. Let
$$P_{n+1,2d}=\{f\in\mathbb{R}[X]_{2d}:f(x)\ge 0\text{ for all }x\in\mathbb{R}^{n+1}\}$$
be the cone of positive semidefinite forms, and let
$$\Sigma_{n+1,2d}=\Big\{\sum_{j} g_j^2 : g_j\in\mathbb{R}[X]_d\Big\}$$
be the cone of sums of squares. Let $\nu_d:\mathbb{P}^n\to\mathbb{P}^{N}$, $N=\binom{n+d}{d}-1$, denote the $d$-th Veronese embedding, and for a real projective variety $V\subseteq\mathbb{P}^N$ containing the Veronese variety $\nu_d(\mathbb{P}^n)$ let
$$C(V)=\{f\in\mathbb{R}[X]_{2d}: \exists\text{ a positive semidefinite Gram matrix for }f\text{ supported on }V\},$$
i.e.\ the set of forms admitting a Gram representation by a positive semidefinite quadratic form on the ambient space of $\mathbb{P}^N$ that vanishes on $V$ modulo the form. Choosing a chain of real projective varieties
$$\nu_d(\mathbb{P}^n)=V_{k(n,d)-n}\subseteq\cdots\subseteq V_1\subseteq V_0=\mathbb{P}^N$$
one obtains a filtration
$$\Sigma_{n+1,2d}=C_0\subseteq C_1\subseteq\cdots\subseteq C_{k(n,d)-n}=P_{n+1,2d},$$
where $C_i:=C(V_i)$. Assume the chain is strictly separating, i.e.\ $C_i\subsetneq C_{i+1}$ for each $i$. For each such intermediate cone $C_i$, give an explicit description of its dual cone
$$C_i^{\vee}:=\{L\in\mathrm{Hom}_{\mathbb{R}}(\mathbb{R}[X]_{2d},\mathbb{R}):L(f)\ge 0\text{ for all }f\in C_i\}$$
in terms of the variety $V_i$ (e.g.\ as moment-type functionals associated with measures, Hankel/moment matrix positivity conditions on $V_i$, or otherwise intrinsic geometric data).
artifact.category_tag: Real algebraic geometry / SOS and PSD cones
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicit open problem ("Give an explicit description of $C_i^\vee$") in the source preprint from November 2024, and no follow-up work resolving it was located in a web search.

status_evidence.title: Intermediate cones between SOS and PSD forms (arXiv:2411.06468)
status_evidence.snippet: Filtration Σ_{n+1,2d}=C_0⊆…⊆C_{k(n,d)-n}=P_{n+1,2d} via Gram matrix method on projective varieties containing the Veronese variety; section on open problems including dual cones.
status_evidence.claim: The explicit description of the dual cone C_i^∨ is stated as an open problem.
